issues.description: nevra[0] indexes the filename's first character, not the package name's first letter, breaking koji's Packages subdirectory convention.
issues.detail: Koji's Packages tree is keyed by the lowercased first letter of the package NAME, but nevra[0] takes the first char of the basename. It works by accident today and breaks silently for any quirky name. Parse the name properly or name the variable filename and document the precondition.

issues.description: extract_arch_from_url returns None silently and the caller interpolates the literal string 'None' into the URL path.
issues.detail: When the regex misses, the function returns None and the caller builds '.../latest/None/Packages/...' with no exception or log. A broken URL ships downstream and fails far from the cause. Either raise on miss, or have the caller refuse to proceed. Defensive-but-useless code.

issues.description: Acknowledged race with coreos-koji-tagger is shipped with no mitigation, retry, or in-code comment.
issues.detail: The commit message concedes the URL is fabricated before the artifact is tagged into coreos-pool, then asserts 'it's safe' without an invariant or detection. At minimum add a retry/verify step or an in-code comment so the next person debugging a 404 finds the reasoning quickly instead of spelunking commit history.

issues.description: Hardcoded arch list and koji_url_base are scattered constants without a single source of truth.
issues.detail: The arch list inside extract_arch_from_url is independent of the arches the caller iterates over, and the koji base URL is a string literal embedded in logic. A change to either silently invalidates the other. Lift both to module-level constants so future edits are a single grep.

issues.description: Word-boundary arch regex can misclassify URLs whose path segments contain an arch substring before the real arch.
issues.detail: search() returns the first match, so a path like '.../ppc64le-mirror/.../x86_64/Packages/...' yields the wrong arch. The arch is already known by the caller and should be threaded in; alternatively split on '/' and intersect with the arch set rather than fighting URL structure with a regex.

issues.description: Stale 'Prioritize the url from fedora-coreos-pool' branch in query_packages_location is now redundant with use_koji_url_only.
issues.detail: use_koji_url_only rewrites every URL downstream, making the prioritization either dead weight or load-bearing with no comment explaining why. Don't leave both halves of a half-finished refactor in the tree — delete it or document why it still matters.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The approach — synthesize the canonical koji path rather than trust dnf5's broken baseurl — is sound, but execution has two concrete defects the panel agrees are blocking: nevra[0] conflates filename-first-char with name-first-letter (works by accident), and extract_arch_from_url silently returns None and lets the caller format 'None' into the URL. The acknowledged race with koji-tagger ships with no in-code mitigation or comment, and hardcoded constants (arch list, koji base URL) are scattered across functions with no single source of truth. The regex-based arch extraction is heavier than the data warrants and can misclassify; thread arch from the caller. Once these are fixed and the now-redundant prioritization branch in query_packages_location is resolved, the patch is in good shape.
